reading: The sketch is a festival hero section: a top nav row ('BLOCKPARTY' / 'LINEUP · TICKETS · MAP'), a giant two-line headline 'LOUD FEST' (yellow/pink), a spinning blue jagged cut-out decoration where a star was drawn, a near-black to pale-yellow gradient section background, and two white bordered cards at the bottom — a small tilted '3 DAYS · 40 ACTS' card and a larger 'Weekend pass' card with copy, a ticket link, and a hard offset shadow.
